name: Visual Picker for ACF Flexible Content
author: gmnuriddin

sections.description:
Visual Picker for ACF Flexible Content replaces the ACF Flexible Content layout dropdown with a visual picker. Each layout becomes a card with a thumbnail, title, and description, so editors see what they’re adding before they add it.

Now free: the three former premium features

These three were previously sold separately as a paid add-on. They are now built into the plugin — no license key, no trial, nothing gated:

  • Instant search — type to filter large layout libraries, with matching text highlighted on every card
  • Multi-select and batch add — select several layouts and insert them all in one click
  • Drag to reorder — arrange your selection into the exact order you want before inserting it

Also included

  • Visual picker replaces the default layout dropdown
  • Thumbnail, title, and description for every layout, set in the ACF field group editor
  • Add a single layout with one click
  • A preview thumbnail inside each layout row while editing
  • Lightweight — no bloat, no external connections, no account required

Requirements

This plugin extends the Flexible Content field, which is part of Advanced Custom Fields PRO. ACF PRO 6.0 or later must be installed and active.
sections.installation:
1. Install and activate Advanced Custom Fields PRO (6.0+).
  2. Install this plugin through the Plugins screen, or upload the ZIP.
  3. Activate it. You’ll be taken to the settings page on first activation.
  4. Open any Flexible Content field in the ACF field group editor and set an image, title, and description for each layout.
  5. When editing a post or page, click “Add Layout” to open the picker modal.
sections.faq:
Does this require ACF PRO?

Yes. The Flexible Content field is a PRO-only feature of Advanced Custom Fields, so ACF PRO 6.0 or later must be active.

Does it work with the free version of ACF?

No — Flexible Content is not available in the free version of ACF, so this plugin needs ACF PRO.

How many layouts can I use?

As many as your field defines. Click a card to add a single layout, or use the numbered badges to select several and add them all at once — subject to whatever maximum the field itself sets.

How do I add more than one layout at a time?

In the picker modal, hover a card and click its circular badge to select it. The badge shows the position it will be added in. Select as many as you like, optionally click “Reorder Selected” to drag them into a different order, then click “Add selected”.

Where do the thumbnails and descriptions come from?

You set them per layout inside the ACF field group editor, in the field’s settings panel.

Is there a paid version?

No. Everything the plugin does is included here for free.
sections.changelog:
1.1.0

  • All previously separate premium features are now included for free: instant search with highlighted matches, multi-select with batch add, and drag-to-reorder before inserting.
  • The settings page now lists the included features instead of pointing to a paid add-on.
  • No changes to layout metadata, storage, or the developer filter — existing field configuration is untouched.

1.0.0

  • First release. A visual modal picker for ACF Flexible Content: preview each layout as a card with a thumbnail, title, and description, then add it with a click.
